prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE standalone planetary building-layer sprite, square transparent PNG, approximately 1024 x 1024.
Purpose: reusable architecture above a SEPARATE biome ground layer. Produce BUILDING ONLY, not a diorama. Genuine zero-alpha transparency around the building; preserve translucent soft shadow. No baked soil, gravel apron, moss, grass, rocks around the site, concrete base tile, raised platform, roads, path, border or landscape. Small integral ramps/steps/support feet belonging to the structure are allowed. Planted roofs and terrace gardens are PART OF THE BUILDING and are allowed; nothing grows around it.
Style: the approved Boreal/Temperate structures, grounded near-future frontier engineering. Soft semi-realistic environmental 3D rendering, matte weathered steel, warm cream and pale-stone panels with grey-green trim, restrained amber service lights and warm windows. Large readable forms, no ink outlines, no cel shading, plastic gloss, extreme contrast, excessive greebles or neon. No text, logos, Authority branding, numerals, UI, people, vehicles or spacecraft.
Camera and lighting: elevated front-left three-quarter view about 55 degrees above the ground plane; more roof than wall, mild perspective; front and right walls visible. Soft upper-left daylight, neutral/cool fill and semi-transparent soft lower-right cast/contact shadow attached to the feet.
Framing/alignment: complete compact structure centered in a square. Building width about 65–70% of canvas, with ample transparent margin. Ground footprint centred at approximately x=50%, y=65%; near/front foot at y≈82%, far/rear foot at y≈45%. A stable site anchor, not a floating base. Never crop. Keep the same compact footprint through all tiers; add height and terraces, not a sprawling campus.
Input image 1 is the house style for frontier HOUSING (panels, windows, roof equipment, scale). Input image 2 is the house style for living crops under glass. Create a NEW building family in that shared style; do not copy either building. Use those two images for materials and rendering, not for their canvas occupancy; follow the requested transparent margins and alignment.
Family identity: stepped garden housing for a lush Gaia world. Homes built as stepped terraces, each step's roof a planted garden of vegetable beds, low shrubs and small fruit trees, with warm-lit windows and small glazed sunrooms on the step faces. Cream and pale-stone walls, grey-green steel trim, slim irrigation piping. A recognizable stepped, green-topped silhouette that reads as "people live here and grow their own food", clearly different from the grey Habitat blocks and the barrel-vaulted Agroplex greenhouses.
Tier progression for context (do NOT draw a lineup): 1 low two-step terrace; 2 three stepped terraces; 3 four levels around a planted courtyard; 4 five levels with rooftop orchards; 5 stepped garden pyramid with a glass atrium; 6 tall terraced garden ziggurat with a waterfall.
Output exactly the single requested tier alone, transparent RGBA PNG, never a contact sheet.
Input image 3 is the preceding garden-pyramid tier and sets the continuing architectural family. Develop its taller final upgrade, maintaining its cream stone, grey-green steel, warm housing windows, planted ledges and one compact footprint. Only draw the upgraded tier.
Subject: LIVING TERRACES — TIER 6 of 6.
This tier specifically: a tall stepped garden ziggurat with lush terraces on every level, small trees on the upper steps and a thin waterfall falling between levels, on the same compact site.
Read clearly as the tallest mature garden-housing ziggurat in this family. A thin natural-looking waterfall cascades from an upper planted terrace down between successive levels into small integral collection basins built into the structure; keep all water inside the building, with no external pond, river, splash apron or terrain. Small fruit trees on upper steps. The structure remains compact and roughly pyramidal, not a campus or skyscraper. Retain practical frontier housing under the greenery. Keep the entire top, all trees, all feet and its soft shadow well inside transparent canvas margins.
postprocessing: Sharp normalized size and site anchor on a transparent1024×1024 canvas, preserving the soft alpha shadow.
